reviewContext.issueReference: No GitHub issue. Operator request 2026-11-11 (workflowInput.requestedBehavior: cancel one running RielaApp instance execution without kill); accepted at step5-impl-plan-review comm-000008 in opus-terra-design-and-implement-review-loop-session-1.
reviewContext.userProblem: On 2026-11-11 overlapping/broken executions of the RielaApp-resident ART hourly instance had to be stopped with kill -TERM on the command-node process (python3 scripts/art.py run) and its nested `riela workflow run art`, because Riela has no way to cancel a single running execution; `riela instance reload --interrupt-running` interrupts ALL executions and reloads the definition.
requiredOutcomes: `riela instance cancel <identity> [--session <sid>] --reason <text> [--wait] [--timeout-seconds N] [--server URL] [--profile P] [--cwd <dir>]` using the same endpoint discovery, identity normalization and JSON output conventions as instance reload|run|executions.
App routes POST /api/v1/instances/{identity}/executions/{sessionId}/cancel and POST /api/v1/instances/{identity}/cancel (desktopOnly, x-riela-profile handling like reload).

Cancelling a running execution terminates its command-node process tree including grandchildren in other process groups (SIGTERM, SIGKILL after 5 s grace); the session ends cancelled with failureReason `operator_cancelled by rielaapp-api:<profile>: <reason>`.
A second concurrently running execution of the same instance is unaffected.

No-session: exactly one live run is cancelled; zero -> no_running_execution; several -> ambiguous_running_sessions (with sessionIds, pendingRunCount); unknown -> session_not_found; finished -> not_running; older App -> app_cancel_unsupported.
After cancel the instance's running slot, cron receipt (cancelled, operator-cancelled:<binding>:<sid>) and admission are released so executions list and cron overlap see it finished.
swift build, focused swift test filters and swiftlint on changed files pass; docs/app-instance-control.md documents the command, routes and error codes.
nonGoals: No change to reload/run/executions behavior, flags or response shapes (additive only); launch snapshot JSON keys unchanged, no new launch status.
No App restart; no change to ~/.riela/** or installed binaries; tests use temp stores and fake processes.
No serve-host (`riela serve`) route and no GraphQL surface.
No change to deadline-timeout kill path, await-owner policy, spawn flags or the normal-exit group kill in LocalProcess.
No change to admission gate semantics, cancelRunning, queue or shutdown receipts; plain events serve without the runtime-environment channel stays byte-identical.
Orphan sessions (running in store, no live runner) are not cancellable; use riela session reconcile.
constraints: Work only in worktree /Users/taco/gits/tacogips/riela-worktrees/instance-cancel; never touch the main checkout or its .build.
Do not restart/kill/reconfigure the running RielaApp; do not modify ~/.riela/** or installed binaries.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Session status `cancelled` with failureKind `.cancelled` and failureReason `operator_cancelled by <actor>: <reason>` via a root-only DeterministicWorkflowRunRequest.cancellationReason closure (plan 02); handover cancellationCause keeps precedence.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Least invasive: the store already has cancelled status; the reason is recorded only on the root run request so fanout/cross-workflow children do not inherit it (design C1, C6).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Shared contracts pinned in new files (OperatorCancellation, WorkflowServeSessionControl frames/acks, LiveSessionCancelRegistry, RielaAppInstanceCancelContract + ports protocol) in wave 1.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Lets wave-2 plans 06-09 implement child, parent channel, App launches and coordinator in parallel against identical types (design C1-C4b).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Events-serve child answers session-cancel/session-list frames on the existing private runtime-environment channel; each in-process run is registered by sessionId and cancelled through its own Task handle (TaskHandleBox handles cancel-before-handle).
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Resident cron/event runs execute in the child; per-session cancellation leaves other runs untouched and releases registry before admission release (design C2, C3, C5).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: App manual runs use a per-identity LiveSessionCancelRegistry in RielaWebWorkflowRuntime; cancelled launches read `failed` in the unchanged launch snapshot while the session reads `cancelled`.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Keeps launch snapshot shape byte-identical while making Task.detached manual runs cancellable by (identity, sessionId) (design C2 item 2, C5).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Pure RielaAppInstanceCancelCoordinator decides from live inventories (never executions history); routes are thin wrappers imitating the reload API.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: All decision branches unit-testable with fake ports; no-session ambiguity/zero/unavailable paths make zero cancel calls (design C4, C4b).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: LocalProcess Task-cancellation with terminateGroup snapshots the descendant tree across process groups, SIGTERMs, waits up to 5 s grace, SIGKILLs with pid+startTime guard, and returns only after the tree is gone.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Nested `riela workflow run` launches commands in separate process groups that survived the old owned-group-only kill (design §2 counterexample, C8).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: CLI maps 404/405 without instance_not_found/session_not_found to app_cancel_unsupported and uses string codes only (plan 05 independent of plan 01 types).
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Older Apps answer the unknown route with the projection 404; wave-1 parallelism (design C7).

intentionalTradeoffs: Cancellation grace rises from 1 s to 5 s for every Task-cancelled terminateGroup LocalProcess node; deadline-timeout path unchanged.
A process-tree snapshot can miss a descendant spawned within one 100 ms scan interval (design §7).
A cancelled manual launch reports `failed` in the launch snapshot (no new status) while its session reads `cancelled`.
The RielaApp handler and ports are covered by compilation plus coordinator and route-table tests only (RielaApp has no XCTest target).
Process-tree survivors after the hard bound are reported as a stderr line `process_tree_survivors <n>` (no telemetry handle in RielaAdapters).
supportedEdgeCases: Cancel requested before the run's Task handle is stored (TaskHandleBox cancels on store).
Second cancel -> alreadyRequested; unknown session -> session_not_found; terminal -> not_running; nonTerminal with no live owner -> session_not_owned; child channel failure -> cancel_unavailable.
No-session with a live run hidden behind many newer terminal sessions -> still cancelled (live inventory, not history).
One live id plus a pending (not-yet-started) run -> ambiguous_running_sessions, nothing cancelled.
Cron cancelRunning supersede wins over operator cancel for the receipt reason.
Leader exits on SIGTERM before nested groups finish cooperative cleanup -> cleanup not preempted; PID reuse guarded by startTime.
Cancel for identity A never reaches a launch of identity B.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Cancelling orphan sessions with no live runner.
Cancel via riela serve host or GraphQL.
Cancelling runs on an App that has not been upgraded (reported as app_cancel_unsupported / cancel_unavailable).
residualRisks: RielaApp cancel handler and ports covered only by compilation plus coordinator and route-table tests (plan 10).
1 s -> 5 s cancellation grace may affect existing timing tests at reconcile (plan 03).
Plan 11 requires `swift build --product riela` before the test and must not skip.
Merge overlap with fix/manual-overlap-terminal-reserve (additive edits only).
Shared .build contention across parallel wave plans: log sibling breaks and re-run, never fix sibling files.
